text:
maria: CI on main is red — linux build of //runtime:inference failing after the toolchain image roll (gcc-12 -> gcc-12.1). Saw this in the failed shard logs, looks like a link error. Can someone take a quick look?

maria: ```
/opt/worker/checkout/bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/runtime/_objs/inference/libinference.a(model.o): In function `Model::init()':
model.cpp:(.text+0x1f3): undefined reference to `__atomic_load_8'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

aj: hmm, undefined reference to __atomic... usually a missing -latomic or a change in libc++/libstdc++ handling. Was the toolchain switch to a newer gcc that changed atomics? :thinking:

devon: pinging the CI job: @ci-bot can you rerun job 89321 (linux-shard-7) with verbose link logs? low-cost rerun to see full link flags.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by devon. Job 89321 rerun queued (jenkins/runner-56). ETA ~2m. :arrows_counterclockwise:

ben: quick check — did we start building with -march=native or change the base image? I remember the image bumped from ubuntu20->ubuntu22 which might pull different libatomic.

aj: if it's libatomic we should see -latomic missing in link flags. Can someone paste `nm -D /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libatomic.so` from the image?

maria: rerun finished, attaching the new link line:```
/usr/bin/c++ ... -Wl,-Bstatic -lprotobuf -Wl,-Bdynamic -lpthread -lrt -ldl
```
I don't see -latomic anywhere.

devon: ok that nails it — new gcc image apparently expects libatomic for some atomics but our link flags were trimmed by the thin LTO/linker wrapper. Quick mitigation: add -latomic to the link line for //runtime:inference or add `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` to the cc_library. Will try a fast patch.

aj: quick bisect idea — the toolchain image roll commit range is 7f3a..b2c1. If someone can run `git bisect run ./devops/scripts/ci-image-smoke.sh` across that range we can confirm which image introduced the behavior. I can run if you want.

ben: I can deploy a hotfix: in //runtime/BUILD add `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` to //runtime:inference_proto_lib and send a tiny CL. Should be safe and unblock main.

maria: please do the CL and mark it `cherrypick: main` if it passes. Also add a TODO comment linking to the toolchain roll so we can revert once infra fixes the image packaging.

ben: CL out: https://phabricator.redwood/PHID-C/CL1234 — added linkopts and a short test. Tagging reviewers @aj @devon. CI triggered. :rocket:

aj: thumbs when green. Also will run the bisect later today to root cause.

ci-bot: Build passed for CL1234 (linux-shard-7). Merging in 2m.

maria: CL merged and main is green again. Thanks all. Filing a follow-up infra ticket to track toolchain image packaging: INFRA-789.

devon: follow-up note: when bisected, the culprit was gcc-image bump that swapped libatomic packaging (commit b1c9e7). I'll add findings to INFRA-789.

maria: nice triage — short-term fix merged, longer-term infra fix tracked. :tada:
